answer: Weight accrues only after a unique-work streak. Registration is merely a bridge: a new key starts at zero and must finish six consecutive epochs of peer-attested unique answers, or a miss resets the count. Keys that share a funding path or near-identical text merge into one streak, so a hollow extra key adds no weight. Established standing is a harbor after that climb. N live identities require N distinct work streams and a slashable bond locked for six epochs each; a cluster proof burns the bond and wipes the streak. Cost is unique labor, idle capital, and slash risk, not a new-address fee.
